abstract: We present a model in which income inequality interacts with banks' risk‐taking incentives, generating financial instability. Competition and deposit insurance cause some banks to lend to lower‐income borrowers at underpriced rates, creating “risky banks” that fail in downturns, while others lend to higher‐income borrowers and avoid default. Rising inequality affects stability by expanding the underpriced loan segment and increasing the share of risky banks. Moreover, borrower risk does not automatically imply bank risk: without risk‐shifting, no bank fails, even as borrowers become riskier. The model identifies when inequality heightens bank risk and clarifies the mechanisms connecting inequality, lending behavior, and financial fragility.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个模型，其中收入不平等与银行的风险承担激励相互作用，从而引发金融不稳定。竞争和存款保险导致部分银行以低于合理定价的利率向低收入借款人放贷，形成在经济下行时倒闭的“风险银行”，而其他银行则向高收入借款人放贷并避免违约。收入不平等的加剧通过扩大低价贷款部分并增加风险银行的占比来影响稳定性。此外，借款人风险并不自动意味着银行风险：在没有风险转移的情况下，即使借款人风险增加，也没有银行会倒闭。该模型识别了不平等何时加剧银行风险，并阐明了连接不平等、放贷行为与金融脆弱性的机制。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Unequal and Unstable: Income Inequality and Bank Risk
title_zh: 不平等与不稳定：收入不平等与银行风险

abstract: Can consumer confidence account for the leading indicator property of household investment (HI) over the US business cycle? We find that it does. Consumer confidence leads HI and housing starts by two and one-quarter, respectively. Household investment increases persistently after a positive confidence shock, and so do total hours worked, output, and real house prices. Quantitatively, confidence shocks account for a substantial share of the forecast error variation in these variables. They are also unrelated to future supply-side fundamentals. Demand-side forces, originating from consumers' social and psychological factors, are therefore relevant to HI dynamics.
title: Consumer confidence and household investment
title_zh: 消费者信心与家庭投资

abstract: Previous literature suggests that the pass-through of oil price shocks to inflation rates became weaker since the 1970s. I use a time-varying parameter VAR to show that this trend has recently been reversed with headline and core inflation rates responding more sensitive to oil price shocks. Based on a counterfactual analysis, I offer evidence that increasingly important second round effects propagated via inflation expectations play a key role for these dynamics. Finally, I illustrate that oil price shocks in general and this expectation channel more specifically contributed substantially to the recent surge in inflation rates.
abstract_zh: 既有文献表明，自1970年代以来，石油价格冲击向通胀率的传导效应已有所减弱。我采用时变参数向量自回归模型（TVP-VAR）证明，这一趋势近期已发生逆转，总体通胀率与核心通胀率对石油价格冲击的反应变得更加敏感。基于反事实分析，我提供的证据表明，通过通胀预期传播的日益重要的第二轮效应在这些动态变化中扮演了关键角色。最后，我阐明石油价格冲击总体上，尤其是这一预期渠道，对近期通胀率的飙升贡献显著。
title: Inflation expectations and time variations in the oil price pass‐through
title_zh: 通胀预期与油价传导效应的时变特征

abstract: We build an endogenous growth model that distinguishes productive and welfare government expenditures and embeds fiscal externalities. The model yields three testable hypotheses: (i) productive expenditure raises growth (Barro effect); (ii) productive expenditure generates cross-country productivity spillovers; (iii) government expenditure structure exhibits spatial dependence. Estimation with a spatial-panel dataset for 30 European economies (EU27 + 3) corroborates all three hypotheses. We further show that positive productivity externalities induce an international free-rider problem, causing systematic under-investment in productive expenditure, while negative welfare externalities trigger a “welfare tournament” and over-spending on non-productive expenditure.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生增长模型，该模型区分了生产性政府支出与福利性政府支出，并嵌入了财政外部性。模型提出了三个可检验的假设：（i）生产性支出促进增长（巴罗效应）；（ii）生产性支出产生跨国生产率溢出效应；（iii）政府支出结构表现出空间依赖性。利用包含30个欧洲经济体（EU27+3）的空间面板数据集进行估计，结果支持了所有三个假设。我们进一步表明，正向的生产率外部性引发国际搭便车问题，导致生产性支出系统性投资不足，而负向的福利外部性则触发“福利竞赛”，导致非生产性支出过度。
title: Interdependence of government expenditure among European countries: Productivity spillover and strategic interaction
title_zh: 欧洲国家政府支出的相互依赖性：生产率溢出与策略互动

abstract: In a basic New Keynesian DSGE model with involuntary unemployment, we study the role of labor markets in the transmission of persistent monetary policy shocks that increase households' inflation expectations. The model predicts that, in contrast to the standard nominal interest rate shocks, labor market conditions can affect the outcomes of persistent monetary policy shocks suggesting a trade-off between inflation and output growth: restricted labor market access leads to higher inflation response with smaller effects on output. Using a vector autoregression analysis, we further provide empirical evidence consistent with the predictions of our theoretical model.
title: Persistent monetary policy in a model with involuntary unemployment
title_zh: 非自愿失业模型中的持续性货币政策

abstract: We examine the regional impacts of the Sino–Japan dispute over the Diaoyu/Senkaku Islands that sparked a Chinese consumer boycott of travel to Japan from August 2012. This boycott caused significant and varied regional impacts across Japan. Prefectures that had higher pre-boycott dependency on Chinese visitors, particularly tourists, experienced the largest negative effects. While the boycott's intensity was strongest in the first 6 months, substantial negative impacts were still observable when averaging across 24 months post-boycott. Our results demonstrate the importance of diversification across traveler types and countries of origin in providing travel services to mitigate risks from political conflicts.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Regional impacts of international tourism boycott: A China—Japan conflict
title_zh: 国际旅游抵制的地域影响：中日冲突

abstract: Using panel data on union locals in the United States we examine the dynamics of the union sector, investigating the impact of inter-union competition on locals' productivity and survival. We find low entry rates, high exit rates and high levels of productivity dispersion in the sector. The entry of new locals is not associated with productivity improvements among incumbents but has a small negative association with locals' survival rates. These findings indicate that inter-union competition is not effective in raising productivity and the effects of creative destruction are weak, with these processes likely insufficient to stem the sector's overall decline.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国工会地方组织的面板数据，考察了工会部门的动态变化，探究了工会间竞争对地方组织生产率及存续的影响。研究发现，该部门进入率低、退出率高，且生产率分散程度高。新地方组织的进入并未与现有组织的生产率提升相关联，反而与其存续率呈轻微负相关。这些结果表明，工会间竞争在提升生产率方面效果有限，创造性破坏的作用较弱，这些过程可能不足以遏制该部门的整体衰退。
title: Productivity dynamics among union locals in the United States
title_zh: 美国工会地方组织的生产率动态

abstract: This study investigates how changes in immigration attitudes in an area spread to other localities. We use the exogenous variation in immigration attitudes from the Associated Press news wire service ban on the term “illegal immigrant,” which previous research has shown made immigration attitudes less hostile in more affected United States counties. We show that respondents in areas more socially connected (via Facebook) to those more affected by the ban exhibited improved immigration attitudes. Additional results suggest the likely channel is changing attitudes in socially connected counties and that people who use social media for political information are more affected.
title: Social networks and spread of immigration attitudes
title_zh: 社交网络与移民态度的传播

abstract: This paper studies the decline in wage inequality in Taiwan from 2004 to 2019 using administrative employer-employee matched data and the Abowd–Kramarz–Margolis (AKM) framework. Unlike the U.S. and Europe, Taiwan experienced an 8.4% drop in wage inequality, driven largely by reductions in within-firm disparities. Minimum wage hikes likely contributed to this compression, as lower-tail inequality declined due to faster earnings growth among low-wage workers, while upper-tail inequality remained relatively stable. AKM estimates, robust to bias correction, indicate that firm-specific wage premiums account for a small share of inequality, while worker-firm sorting has become increasingly important in explaining wage dispersion.
authors: Po‐Chun Huang, Huei‐Ming Chen, Hsien‐Ming Lien, Tzu‐Ting Yang
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Dynamics and sources of wage inequality in Taiwan: Evidence from employer‐employee matched data
title_zh: 台湾工资不平等的动态与来源：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据

abstract: This paper re-examines the relationship between debt and growth with and without the influence of global shocks for a panel of 22 economies. The analysis introduces an approach that accounts for the complexity of global factors and estimates the debt-to-growth and growth-to-debt nexus for household, corporate, and public debt from a purely idiosyncratic perspective. The results reveal a multifactor structure: global shocks drive variation in household and public debt, whereas corporate debt exhibits predominantly idiosyncratic dynamics. These global shocks alter the magnitude and statistical significance of the idiosyncratic debt-growth nexus, demonstrating their critical role in identifying the underlying relationship.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了22个经济体面板数据中，在考虑与不考虑全球冲击影响下，债务与增长之间的关系。分析引入了一种方法，该方法考虑了全球因素的复杂性，并从纯粹的特质视角估计了家庭、企业和公共债务对增长及增长对债务的相互影响。结果显示存在多因素结构：全球冲击驱动家庭和公共债务的变化，而企业债务则表现出主要特质动态。这些全球冲击改变了特质债务-增长关系的规模和统计显著性，证明了它们在识别潜在关系中的关键作用。
title: Global shocks and the debt‐growth nexus
title_zh: 全球冲击与债务-增长关联

abstract: We examined the effect of different payment methods on charitable donations through a lab experiment. Participants participated in a real donation scenario where they could choose between cash or contactless mobile payments. The results indicate that contactless mobile payment led to higher donation amounts compared to cash. We suggest that the greater familiarity with the payment mode plays a significant role in increasing donation, particularly as the widespread use of contactless payments during pandemic lockdowns likely made people more comfortable with mobile payments, resulting in more generous donations.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验室实验考察了不同支付方式对慈善捐赠的影响。参与者在真实捐赠情境中可选择现金或非接触式移动支付。结果显示，相较于现金，非接触式移动支付带来了更高的捐赠金额。我们认为，对支付方式的更高熟悉度在促进捐赠中扮演重要角色，尤其是在疫情期间封锁期间非接触支付的广泛使用，可能使人们更习惯于移动支付，从而表现出更慷慨的捐赠行为。
title: Cash versus contactless mobile payment: The effect of payment modes on donation behaviors
title_zh: 现金与非接触式移动支付：支付方式对捐赠行为的影响

abstract: Recent work suggests that cross-country convergence has strengthened over time. Here we explore mobility and convergence in relative income and relative total factor productivity (TFP) using finite state Markov chains. We find that low-income countries rarely improve their position relative to the US. Since capital-output ratios have approached or exceeded the US level and human capital is converging, the persistence of low relative income seems to originate in low relative TFP. We study the dynamics of relative TFP, how they have changed, and how they interact with absolute levels of human capital, casting new light on the future of convergence.
title: Dynamic development accounting and relative income traps
title_zh: 动态发展核算与相对收入陷阱

abstract: In this paper, we report on two experimental studies that examine the impact of social distance on delegation and uncover the role of anonymity driving delegation in a principal-agent setting. Study 1 shows that reducing the social distance makes principals less likely to delegate. Study 2 offers evidence that the likelihood of delegation is not affected by whether the principal is informed that the recipients will not find out whether the principal is their friend or a stranger. Our findings have implications for the underlying sources of pro-sociality in organizational settings where managers make their decisions through hiring external agents.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了两项实验研究，探讨社会距离对委托的影响，并揭示了匿名性在委托-代理情境中驱动委托行为的作用。研究一表明，缩短社会距离会降低委托人进行委托的可能性。研究二提供证据显示，委托人是否被告知接收者不会知晓其身份（朋友或陌生人）并不影响委托的可能性。我们的发现对组织环境中管理者通过雇佣外部代理人做出决策时亲社会行为的潜在来源具有启示意义。
title: Social distance and delegation: Does anonymity matter?
title_zh: 社会距离与委托：匿名性是否重要？

abstract: We show that culturally transmitted individualism is an important determinant of working from home (WFH). Using individual-level data from the U.S. Current Population Survey (CPS) and the European Social Survey (ESS), we compare immigrants and their descendants from different cultural backgrounds residing in the same location. A 10-point increase in country-of-origin individualism (0–100 scale) increases the likelihood of WFH by 3.9 percentage points and WFH hours by 1.12 per week in the CPS, and frequent WFH by 2 percentage points in the ESS. Individualism appears to affect WFH partly through higher educational attainment and occupational selection.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，文化传承的个人主义是居家办公（WFH）的一个重要决定因素。利用美国当前人口调查（CPS）和欧洲社会调查（ESS）的个体层面数据，我们比较了居住在同一地区的不同文化背景的移民及其后代。在原籍国个人主义指数（0-100分制）上每增加10分，CPS中居家办公的可能性提高3.9个百分点，每周居家办公小时数增加1.12小时；在ESS中，频繁居家办公的比例提高2个百分点。个人主义似乎部分通过更高的教育成就和职业选择影响居家办公。
title: Individualism and working from home
title_zh: 个人主义与居家办公

abstract: This paper examines how the interaction of business cycles with the source of fluctuations and macroeconomic uncertainty shapes the impact of tax news on output. Using tax news from the municipal bond market and a smooth transition local projection, we find anticipated tax cuts are more contractionary in supply-driven than demand-driven recessions, and in high-uncertainty than low-uncertainty recessions. High market congestion in supply-driven recessions and elevated real option values in high-uncertainty recessions contribute to these stronger contractionary effects. The findings suggest that countercyclical tax policies may have unintended impacts during anticipation periods, depending on business cycle sources and uncertainty levels.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了商业周期与波动来源及宏观经济不确定性之间的相互作用如何影响税收新闻对产出的效应。利用市政债券市场的税收新闻及平滑转换局部投影法，我们发现，预期中的减税在供给驱动型衰退中比在需求驱动型衰退中更具紧缩性，在高不确定性衰退中比在低不确定性衰退中更具紧缩性。供给驱动型衰退中的高市场拥挤度及高不确定性衰退中上升的真实期权价值，共同导致了这些更强的紧缩效应。研究结果表明，逆周期税收政策在预期期间可能产生非预期影响，其效果取决于商业周期的来源及不确定性水平。
title: The business cycle state‐dependent effects of tax news: A joint‐state analysis
title_zh: 税收新闻的商业周期状态依赖效应：联合状态分析

abstract: The Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) schedule and lump-sum disbursement can create significant labor supply responses. I estimate labor supply responses to tax credit disbursements using a regression kink design. Among single workers, credits increase labor supply around the time that tax credits are disbursed at the first and second kinks in the EITC schedule but reduce labor supply on the intensive margin at the third kink. There is some evidence of heterogeneous responses among married women, including an increase in labor supply near the third kink, although findings in the sample of married women appear less robust.
title: Labor supply responses to tax credit disbursements: Evidence from the EITC schedule
title_zh: 税收抵免发放对劳动供给的反应：来自EITC计划的证据

abstract: Do religious beliefs affect responses to fertility incentives? We examine a 1982 maternity benefits expansion in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania in a difference-in-differences framework with similar East European countries as comparisons. To isolate the importance of religion, we compare women who did and did not grow up in religious households when religion was formally outlawed, resulting in similar adult characteristics among women in the Baltics by importance of religion. Maternity benefits increased fertility only among women who grew up in religious families, providing novel evidence that cultural norms transmitted through the family can amplify the effects of public policies.
abstract_zh: 宗教信仰是否会影响人们对生育激励的反应？我们利用1982年爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛的产假福利扩展，在双重差分框架下，以相似的东欧国家作为对照组进行比较。为隔离宗教的重要性，我们比较了在宗教被正式禁止时期成长于宗教家庭与非宗教家庭的女性，结果显示波罗的海国家女性在成年特征上因宗教重要性而相似。产假福利仅提高了在宗教家庭中成长的女性的生育率，这提供了新的证据表明，通过家庭传递的文化规范可以放大公共政策的效果。
title: How religion mediates the fertility response to maternity benefits
title_zh: 宗教如何调节生育福利对生育率的影响

abstract: We formulate a model of an open economy with three final goods sectors, one of which uses a continuum of tasks as inputs. Skilled labor or artificial intelligence (AI), which is produced using skilled labor and capital, can conduct these tasks. We explore the effects of technical progress in AI, showing how AI competes with skilled labor in tasks and the consequences for wage inequality and the skill premium. We consider the effectiveness of trade tariffs and a direct AI tax to counter negative impacts of advancements in AI technology on the range of tasks performed by skilled labor.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含三个最终产品部门的开放经济模型，其中一个部门使用连续统任务作为投入。熟练劳动力或人工智能（AI），后者由熟练劳动力和资本生产，可以执行这些任务。我们探讨了AI技术进步的影响，展示了AI如何在任务中与熟练劳动力竞争，以及对工资不平等和技能溢价的影响。我们考虑了贸易关税和直接AI税在缓解AI技术发展对熟练劳动力执行任务范围负面冲击方面的有效性。
title: Tariffs, taxes and wages in the age of artificial intelligence
title_zh: 人工智能时代的关税、税收与工资

abstract: Macroeconomic models of government spending often depend on behavioral details with poor microeconomic validity. We propose a model that is more resistant to this critique in an effort to obtain credible estimates of key policy multipliers. Its success derives from the union of two separate but mutually reinforcing transmission mechanisms: (𝑖)
abstract_zh: 政府支出的宏观经济模型往往依赖于微观经济有效性较差的微观行为细节。我们提出了一种更能抵御这一批评的模型，以期获得关键政策乘数的可信估计。其成功源于两个独立但相互强化的传导机制的结合：（一）
title: Strengthening the micro origins of macro multipliers via partial insurance and increasing returns
title_zh: 通过部分保险和递增报酬强化宏观乘数的微观基础

abstract: How are contracts enforced when the state cannot compel compliance? We study contract enforcement in a large illegal gambling market where legal recourse is unavailable and participation is largely anonymous. We observe more than 70 percent of gamblers repay their debts, indicating substantial baseline enforcement even in the absence of formal courts. We interpret this descriptive pattern as consistent with a broader set of informal enforcement forces, including repeated interaction, credit constraints, and reputational considerations. We then provide experimental evidence on one specific channel by experimentally varying reputational stakes and the time available to repay. Increasing reputational sanctions and extending the payment deadline raises repayment by a modest but significant amount, from roughly 70 percent to about 77 percent. These effects imply that reputational incentives can strengthen cooperation to a meaningful degree. Overall, our evidence suggests that impersonal markets can sustain substantial repayment without state enforcement, and that reputational sanctions further increase compliance.
title: Contract enforcement in a stateless economy
title_zh: 无国家经济中的合同执行

abstract: I explore how non-linear health insurance contracts allow consumers to substitute healthcare in one period for healthcare in another period by increasing consumption in the year the annual deductible was met and decreasing future consumption. I exploit variation in the timing of an injury that generates significant healthcare expenses to identify the causal effect of meeting the deductible on healthcare consumption in the following year. Estimates indicate that there is intertemporal substitution across years in healthcare consumption and that consumers are able to strategically respond to non-linear pricing schemes to undermine the potential savings from deductible plans.
title: Intertemporal substitution in response to non-linear health insurance contracts
title_zh: 非线性健康保险合同中的跨期替代

abstract: We develop and extend notions of potentials for normal-form games (Monderer and Shapley, 1996) to present a unified approach for the general class of social environments. The different potentials and corresponding social environments can be ordered in terms of their permissiveness. We classify different methods to construct potentials and we characterize potentials for specific examples such as matching problems, vote trading, multilateral trade, TU games, and various pillage games.
title: Potentials in social environments
title_zh: 社会环境中的潜力
